subject: Capacity greenlight & offer approval: Billing Ops Sr. Associate + FP&A Analyst
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity greenlight & offer approval: Billing Ops Sr. Associate + FP&A Analyst

Hi all,

Quick ask: we have two near-final candidates that need an expedited greenlight so recruiting can extend offers this week. Details below and attachments included (comp bands + budget calc + draft offer letters).

1) Billing Ops — Sr. Associate (req BOPS-221)
   - Preferred candidate: Carlos Rios (recruiter: TalentLoop)
   - Proposed package: base $130,000 + 10% target bonus + $6k sign-on (counteroffer on table from current employer)
   - Start target: 4/20/2026

2) FP&A — Analyst (req FPNA-117)
   - Preferred candidate: Anita Kumar (internal referral, verbal ok)
   - Proposed package: base $105,000 + 8% target bonus, no sign-on requested
   - Start target: 5/4/2026

Asks:
- Approve releasing the offers at the proposed comp and sign-on for Carlos (we're asking for an exception to standard sign-on cap to match counter).
- Confirm headcount/budget availability and whether we should route through finance for any one-time funds.

Attachments: Offer_Carlos_Rios_BillingOps.pdf, Offer_FPNA_Analyst_AnitaKumar.pdf, Comp_Bands_Q1_2026.xlsx, Budget_Impact_calc_March2026.xlsx

Notes: hiring plan shows budgeted headcount for both roles but sign-on approval is the question. If we have a greenlight by COB Wed (3/25), recruiting can move fast.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity greenlight & offer approval: Billing Ops Sr. Associate + FP&A Analyst

Monica — thanks for the summary. Two quick asks before I sign off:
1) Total first-year fully-loaded cost (base + target bonus + benefits + sign-on) for both hires combined.
2) Confirmation manager has signed off on the salary above the midpoint (if applicable).

If the total annualized run-rate fits within the current hiring plan and the manager confirms midpoint exception for Carlos, I’m comfortable approving the $6k sign-on given the counter.

Vivek
VP Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity greenlight & offer approval: Billing Ops Sr. Associate + FP&A Analyst

Vivek — attaching Budget_Impact_calc_March2026.xlsx with line items. Summary below:

- Carlos (Billing Ops): first-year fully-loaded = $130k base + $13k target bonus + $6k sign-on + ~$35k benefits/eq = $184k
- Anita (FP&A): first-year fully-loaded = $105k base + $8.4k target bonus + $0 sign-on + ~$29k benefits = $142.4k
- Combined first-year hit = $326.4k (one-time sign-on included)

Headcount: both roles are within the OPP-approved hiring plan for FY26 (Karthik can confirm burn schedule). Manager (Karthik) has confirmed midpoint exemption for Carlos to be offered at $130k to match market and retain candidate.

Requesting formal approval to release both offers. Recruiting has candidates ready to sign and Carlos has a competing counter; timing is tight.

Thanks,
Monica

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Rios <carlos.rios@gmail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-26T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Offer: Senior Associate, Billing Operations (Redwood Inference)

Carlos — following up from our call. Please see attached your formal offer and the DocuSign link below. We are excited about the possibility of you joining Redwood. Quick highlights: base $130,000, target bonus 10%, $6,000 one-time sign-on, standard benefits, start date 20 April 2026 (flexible by two weeks).

[Attachment: Offer_Carlos_Rios_BillingOps.pdf (pdf)]
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/sandbox/ZXCVB-12345

Please review and sign electronically. If you have immediate questions or a counter, reply here and cc Monica.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Technical Recruiter — Redwood Inference

All — quick update: Carlos accepted verbally and will sign the DocuSign this morning (Laura confirmed). Requesting final sign-off to release the $6k one-time sign-on and a $2k relocation stipend (manager recommends to smooth transition). Budget impact calc (attached) already includes the $6k; relocation stipend is a one-time $2k draw from team discretionary onboard budget.

If I don’t hear objections by EOD PST, please consider this approved and recruiting will close the loop. Thanks for the quick turnaround — much appreciated.
